sections.title: SUMMARY
sections.text: Business and Economics student with two years of B2B sales and reporting experience. Met a monthly sales target of EUR 50,000 and automated pricing and reporting in Excel. Available from December: 20 h/week, Vienna.

lines.label: Sales:
lines.text: Account management · Negotiation · Pricing & offer preparation · Pipeline reporting

lines.label: Analytics & tools:
lines.text: Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, VBA) · PowerPoint · SQL · Python · Salesforce

bullets: Met a monthly sales target of EUR 50,000 by managing 40 B2B accounts end to end.
Grew monthly sales by 20% within three months through a data-driven prospecting routine.
Cut proposal preparation time by 60% with an automated Excel pricing model.
Prepared monthly sales, margin and forecast reports for management.
Led a team of 6 on a market-entry study for a local start-up; findings adopted by the founders.
Secured 5 corporate sponsors (EUR 10,000+ in total) for the club's annual conference.
Courses: Econometrics, Finance, Business Analytics, Accounting.
